text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, surrounded by so much nature...!
It really clears my head!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we can refresh ourselves as much as we want here!
Thanks for coming with me, Tact-chan!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You seemed to have had a rough time lately, Kiseki-senpai.
If I recall, you were cooped up working, was it...?
Fufu, please refresh yourself to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I'm not catching anything...
Since I'm here, I really wanted to try that whole "eating what you catch yourself" thing~...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Wait,
what's wrong, Tact-chan?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...
There were so many turban snails,
so I thought I'd be able to gather them quickly.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
You can eat this clam!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is delicious.
However, the meat is a bit tricky to extract,
making the preparation quite laborious...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, actually, that's awesome! Let's do it!
I want to experience that taste, effort and all...!
It's not every day you get a chance like this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew, we gathered quite a lot~!
...Turns out there are plenty of edible things out there that I never even knew about.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looking into them is quite fun.
Speaking of lesser-known ones...
That starfish over there, for example.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh... WHAAAT!?
You can actually eat starfish!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, provided it is prepared properly.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that right... A starfish...
A starfish...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...—Hey, Tact-chan!
I wanna try eating starfish too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If I miss this chance, I'll regret it...! Every single experience will feed into my manga...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-senpai... Yes, understood.
Let's try doing it together, starting from the gathering.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you for the food!
...T-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-I see, so this is what starfish tastes like...!
I never could have imagined this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It truly feels like a whole new sensation!
I have to make sure I never forget this experience...!
